hero.description: metriX is a social listening and analytics platform that helps organizations monitor digital conversations, measure engagement, understand sentiment, and discover important trends at the right time.

features.title: Everything you need to understand your digital presence
features.description: From monitoring to AI-powered interpretation, metriX brings the key workflows into one clear experience.
items: Track keywords, brands, and topics across multiple channels from one place.
Bring posts, comments, and engagement into one unified, filterable feed.
Automatically extract sentiment, topics, summaries, and important patterns.
Monitor volume, reach, engagement, and share of voice in clear dashboards.
Detect unusual spikes and potential crises before they escalate.
Separate accounts, projects, and permissions for every client or team.

steps: Add your brand name, keywords, and topics you want to monitor.
Connect data sources and start collecting mentions and engagement.
Use metrics, analytics, and AI to surface what matters.

insights.title: Do not just watch the numbers. Understand why they changed.
insights.description: Let AI summarize the most important changes, topics, risks, and opportunities instead of reading thousands of mentions manually.
